# Issue 4: Define room and object models

## Summary

Define the internal room and object models that support scanning, correction, editing, validation, and local persistence.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Stable identifiers
- [ ] Dimensions
- [ ] Position
- [ ] Rotation
- [ ] Confidence
- [ ] Object status
- [ ] Original arrangement
- [ ] Saved layouts
- [ ] Schema version

## Notes

Follow `docs/DATA_MODEL.md`. Keep models testable and independent from view state where practical.
